policies.name: Property
policies.fullDescription: Property Coverages including Business Personal Property, Optional Coverages like Valuable Papers and Water Backup, with Special Form Cause of Loss.
keyFeatures: Special Form Cause of Loss Including Theft.
Replacement Cost Valuation for covered property.
Coverage for newly acquired buildings and business personal property.
Water Backup and Sump Overflow coverage included.

covered: Damage to business personal property from a covered peril like fire or theft.
Loss of valuable papers due to a covered event.
Water damage from a backed-up sewer or sump overflow.
Theft of tools or equipment while in transit to a job site.
notCovered: Losses due to nuclear events or war.
Losses from certain terrorism acts if TRIA terminates.
Damage from fungi or bacteria exceeding the aggregate limit.
Losses from virus or bacteria as per exclusion.

policies.name: Commercial Excess Liability
policies.description: Provides additional liability coverage above primary policies.
policies.fullDescription: Excess Liability coverage with a General Aggregate limit of $5,000,000 and Each Occurrence limit of $5,000,000, providing additional protection over underlying policies.
keyFeatures: Broad coverage for various liability exposures.
Includes optional coverage for Additional Insureds - Auto Status.
Provides excess protection over underlying General Liability and Products/Completed Operations.
Terrorism coverage inclusion increases premium by $67.00.

covered: Legal defense costs exceeding primary General Liability limits.
Large bodily injury claims from a covered incident that exhaust primary limits.
Property damage claims exceeding primary policy limits.
Coverage for claims arising from products or completed operations.

policies.name: General Liability
policies.description: Comprehensive liability protection for your business operations.
policies.fullDescription: General Liability coverage with limits for General Aggregate, Products-Completed Operations Aggregate, Personal and Advertising Injury, Damage to Premises Rented to You, Each Occurrence, and Medical Expense.
keyFeatures: Includes Bail Bonds Supplementary Payment of $750.
Extended Nonowned Watercraft Coverage for watercraft less than 51 feet long.
Automatic Additional Insured status for Completed Operations when required in construction agreements.
Automatic Waiver of Transfer of Rights of Recovery against others when required in a contract.

covered: Bodily injury to a third party at the client's premises.
Property damage caused by client's operations or completed work.
Legal defense costs for covered liability claims.
Medical expenses for minor injuries to non-employees on premises.

policies.name: Inland Marine
policies.fullDescription: Contractors' Equipment Coverage for unscheduled equipment, with a maximum item limit of $2,500 and an overall limit of $150,000.
keyFeatures: All Insured Perils coverage for contractors' equipment.
Includes Common Policy Conditions and Inland Marine General Terms.
Terrorism forms will be applied as appropriate upon policy issuance.

covered: Theft of a contractor's tool from a job site.
Damage to equipment during transit to or from a job site.
Loss of equipment due to a covered peril while at a temporary location.
notCovered: Losses from certain terrorism acts if TRIA terminates.
Damage to equipment exceeding the maximum item limit for unscheduled items.

considerations: Terrorism coverage is offered but can be rejected, and may be partially reimbursed by the U.S. government.
The Terrorism Risk Insurance Act (TRIA) program is scheduled to terminate on December 31, 2027, which may alter coverage terms.
TRIA includes a $100 billion cap on U.S. government reimbursement and insurer liability for terrorism losses.
Certain terrorism events (e.g., nuclear, biological, chemical, or large-scale damage) may be excluded if the TRIA program terminates.
Payment options other than full pay include a per-installment fee.
coverageStrengths: Rated A+ by both A.M. Best and Standard & Poor's, demonstrating unparalleled financial strength.
Named in the top 50 best-run carriers every year since 2000 by Ward Financial Group.
Offers best-in-class claims handling with 24/7 reporting and 99.8% same-day contact.
Award-winning service with real, live people answering questions and 69 technology awards.
Experienced independent agents provide professional service and access to multiple options.
